BackstoryDef.title: wandering frontier gunslinger
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent years riding between isolated settlements, settling trouble with a sixgun and patching up those left behind. A dusty hat and weathered brown coat became familiar signs of help on the frontier. Long practice taught [PAWN_objective] to take a quick sight picture and recover exceptionally fast between shots.

li.label: frontier sixgun training
li.description: Years as a wandering frontier gunslinger taught [PAWN_nameDef] to aim quickly and recover even faster. Ranged warmup time ×75%; ranged cooldown time ×50%. This training comes from the wandering frontier gunslinger backstory.
